# Pull request

## Summary

Describe what this change does and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (a program or module now behaves correctly)
- [ ] Documentation (README, chapter notes, docstrings)
- [ ] New example or library function
- [ ] Maintenance (tests, tooling, CI)

## Checklist

- [ ] The code follows the [coding style](../docs/coding_style.md) (PEP 8,
      NumPy-style docstrings).
- [ ] `pytest` passes locally.
- [ ] `python tools/format_repository.py` reports no issues.
- [ ] Any new physics is **verified** against an exact result, a limiting case,
      or an independent method, and the check is printed to the console.
- [ ] Stochastic code uses a fixed random seed.
- [ ] I have not altered the scientific content of an existing example without a
      clear reason described above.
